## About
Lil Ikes Auto Collision is a local, family owned and operated body shop on Avenue C in Houston, inside the loop and just blocks away from the port of Houston. We fix collision and frame damage on all makes and models.
Ike learned the trade as a boy helping his father, Big Ike. He opened this shop with his wife, Hilda Caballero, and their son Amos. Amos is now our general manager. He studied at the Masters School of Auto Body Management and has kept learning as the industry has changed with new technology.
We've served customers and their families, businesses and government contracts, and we aim to treat everyone with respect, integrity and quality work. We see this shop as a ministry. Our customers rate us 4.8 on Google from 62 reviews.

## Services
- Collision and frame repair: Body and frame repair after an accident, on all makes and models.
- Insurance claim help: Our claims specialist handles your insurance claim and answers your questions along the way.
- Auto glass repair: Repair for your vehicle's glass.
- Restoring classic cars: We bring classic cars back to their original beauty.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: All makes and models, including BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Volvo, Mazda, Lexus, Cadillac, Ford, Toyota and Land Rover.

Q: Can you help me get my car towed in?
A: For towing around the clock, call Mel at A&I Wrecker at 713-206-6420.
